scope: Audit of real delivered artifacts and merged application behavior; local checks and independent probes are additional verification, not new model calls.

review_acceptance.criterion: Accept one or more signed base-10 integers with an optional leading sign and ASCII digits; reject missing or invalid operands.
review_acceptance.evidence: sum-core.mjs validates operands with /^[+-]?[0-9]+$/ and rejects an empty list. The five unit cases pass, including whitespace, newline, exponent, decimal, and non-ASCII digit inputs.

review_acceptance.criterion: Sum with arbitrary precision and print only the normalized decimal result plus a newline, exiting 0 on valid input.
review_acceptance.evidence: sum-core.mjs uses BigInt and toString(); sum.mjs writes the result and newline. Direct smoke cases produced -2, 0, and the exact large sum. The supplied E2E report confirms four subprocess cases passed.

review_acceptance.criterion: For no operands or invalid input, leave stdout empty, emit an English diagnostic to stderr, and exit 2.
review_acceptance.evidence: sum.mjs catches validation errors, writes the diagnostic to stderr, and sets exitCode to 2. tests/e2e.test.mjs asserts these streams and status; the supplied matching-head E2E result reports success.

review_acceptance.criterion: Provide native node:test unit cases and actual subprocess E2E coverage for mixed signs, zero, single input, large values, and invalid input.
review_acceptance.evidence: tests/test.test.mjs and tests/e2e.test.mjs cover the required cases. The unit file passes all five tests locally; the supplied verification reports all four E2E cases passing.

review_acceptance.criterion: Document CLI usage and both configured test commands in README.
review_acceptance.evidence: README.md documents the invocation, accepted operands, output and exit behavior, and both configured commands.

review_acceptance.criterion: Use no third-party runtime dependency and leave NexKit workflow or policy files unchanged; no release or deployment.
review_acceptance.evidence: The base-to-head diff contains only README.md, sum.mjs, sum-core.mjs, tests/test.test.mjs, and tests/e2e.test.mjs. No dependency, workflow, policy, or release files changed.

review_limitations: Local E2E subprocess execution is blocked by the sandbox (spawnSync returns EPERM). The supplied verification record for this candidate head reports all four E2E cases passing.
The review checkout has 15 unstaged deletions under .agents/skills and .claude/skills; none are part of the reviewed base-to-head diff.
consumers.independent_conclusion: Approved requirement fulfilled; no genuine behavioral defect found.

review_acceptance.criterion: GET /health uses the existing loopback listener and CLI port selection, and returns HTTP 200, application/json, and {"status":"ok"}.
review_acceptance.evidence: service.py adds the route before the existing fallback; main() still binds to 127.0.0.1 using args.port. tests/test_http.py exercises /health against a subprocess launched with --port 0. The supplied verification reports that test passed.

review_acceptance.criterion: Preserve normalization behavior for case, whitespace, Unicode, punctuation, and missing or blank text.
review_acceptance.evidence: The normalize function and existing unit assertions are unchanged. The supplied unit and HTTP verification logs report all 6 tests in each suite passed; I independently ran the unit suite successfully.

review_acceptance.criterion: Preserve unknown routes returning HTTP 404 with {"error":"not_found"}.
review_acceptance.evidence: The existing unknown-route branch and HTTP assertion remain intact. The supplied HTTP verification reports test_unknown_route passed.

review_acceptance.criterion: Add real-service regression coverage for /health and document the endpoint.
review_acceptance.evidence: tests/test_http.py checks status, JSON content type, and parsed body through its live-service helper. README.md documents the endpoint and response. The supplied HTTP verification reports test_health_response passed.

review_acceptance.criterion: Keep the unit, HTTP, and package suites independently runnable with actual cases; ensure the packaged application still runs correctly.
review_acceptance.evidence: README.md retains all three separate commands. The supplied verification reports 6 unit, 6 HTTP, and 6 package tests passed, including test_extracted_archive_serves_real_http checking both normalization and /health. I independently ran the unit suite and five offline package-builder cases successfully.

review_acceptance.criterion: Add no third-party dependencies, external services, or authentication; do not modify NexKit workflow or policy files; do not release or deploy.
review_acceptance.evidence: The base-to-candidate diff changes only README.md, service.py, tests/test_http.py, and tests/test_package.py. The route uses the existing standard-library response path; no dependency, workflow, policy, release, or deployment changes appear in the candidate diff.

review_limitations: Local HTTP checks were unavailable because this runner disables local sockets. The supplied verification record for this candidate reports all 6 HTTP tests and all 6 package tests passed, including the live-service and extracted-package HTTP cases.
consumers.independent_conclusion: Approved requirement fulfilled; no genuine behavioral defect found.

limitations: No raw private CLI logs were inspected; no new model invocation was made.
These two schema-1 successes do not establish live repair, interruption/cancellation, release or stage-approval acceptance.
